note: Declarative registry of the deterministic floor. The canonical prose registry stays in .agents/skills/quality-guardian/references/deterministic-floor.md — it is documentation for humans; THIS file is what the runner executes. Keep ids in sync: a check here without a registry entry there (or vice versa) is a defect caught by `dops verify --audit-registry`.

lanes.browser: needs playwright + a served build; run sequentially (one browser at a time)

profile_note: Profiles select which GROUPS run. The blocking core (D1-D14, D16-D21) is present in every profile — [E.4] holds: budgets never downgrade blocking checks. quick omits only Tier-2 advisory checks, which never block by definition.

checks.title: Build / typecheck
checks.fix_hint: Fix the build error before anything else — every downstream check reads the built output.

checks.title: Browser floor: console, viewports, tap targets, lab perf, a11y, functional paths
checks.fix_hint: Read the per-check lines in the output: each names the route, viewport and measured value.

checks.title: Contrast (WCAG core token pairs)
checks.fix_hint: Adjust the semantic token, never the component. Re-run compile-tokens.py afterwards.

checks.title: Typography: base size, measure, line-height, scale, font usage
checks.fix_hint: All five live in the type scale — fix the scale in tokens, not per-element.

checks.title: Token usage (no raw values in components)
checks.fix_hint: A raw color/font/spacing in a component breaks the restyle property [A.7]. Move it to a semantic token.

checks.title: Placeholders, hotlinks, image hygiene
checks.fix_hint: All images local, real alt, <=300KB, declared width/height; no lorem, no external CDN.

checks.title: Ban-list (AI-look defaults) on the final build
checks.fix_hint: A justified exception needs an ALLOW: line in the final direction doc — not a silent pass.

checks.title: Skeleton marker state
checks.fix_hint: While Gate 2 is deferred the marker is KEPT by design; after K2B scaling it must be gone.

checks.title: Divergence (only when K2B ran)
checks.fix_hint: Directions must differ on >=4 axes; overlap <=50% in the blind test.

checks.title: UX model validation
checks.fix_hint: Pattern, screens, one p1 per screen, states, scenario coverage — all required in standard/full.

checks.title: Pipeline integrity (gate order, enums, decision log)
checks.fix_hint: This one catches retro-fitted compliance: fix the process record, never the check.

checks.title: Nothing silently: autonomous granted, machine gate decisions announced
checks.fix_hint: Announce the decision AT THE MOMENT with a rollback command (`dops announce`), and record the owner's grant before switching to autonomous. Silence is not a grant.

checks.title: Checkpoint log integrity (closed registry, no action on a superseded artifact)
checks.fix_hint: A machine decision needs announced_at [A.26]; a decision on a superseded checkpoint means the owner acted on an artifact that no longer exists in that form — republish it and ask again.

checks.title: Provisional work is never delivered as product (gate-overtaking)
checks.fix_hint: The machine may work ahead of an unanswered gate; it may not call the result ready. Batch-confirm the gate, or veto it — `dops hash plan <changed-input>` scopes the rework.

checks.title: Visual regression
checks.fix_hint: An unapproved diff blocks. `approve` is a HUMAN decision recorded in the decision log.

checks.title: Secrets scan
checks.fix_hint: Secrets live in env only. A documented false positive carries SECRET-ALLOW: on the same line.

checks.title: Service packs acceptance
checks.fix_hint: A core pack not active caps the verdict at ready_with_caveats [A.6]; peripheral is a report line.

checks.title: Extended contrast (text tiers, status hues, focus ring, both themes)
checks.fix_hint: Extends D3 to the full semantic contract — fix in tokens, both themes.

checks.title: Focus visible
checks.fix_hint: No naked `outline: none`; style :focus-visible with >=2px indicator.

checks.title: Semantic HTML
checks.fix_hint: One h1, continuous hierarchy, <main> present, no interactive divs [A.18].

checks.title: Reduced motion
checks.fix_hint: Any motion needs a prefers-reduced-motion quiet version [A.17].

checks.title: AI-look markers
checks.fix_hint: Tier-1 markers (indigo-600, slate-900, indigo->purple) are statistical defaults — replace the palette.

checks.title: Jank-safe motion (transform/opacity only)
checks.fix_hint: Animate transform/opacity only; linear easing is banned.

checks.title: Copy audit (corporate slop)
checks.fix_hint: Replace slop with concrete claims and numbers [A.22].

checks.title: Token architecture (primitive -> semantic -> component)
checks.fix_hint: A component token may reference semantic only — never back down the chain [A.21].

checks.title: Dark ramp matches the declared model
checks.fix_hint: The dark tones are generated from $meta.darkModel. Change the model and re-run `dops skin darkramp`; a tone edited by hand is drift [A.10]. A skin that declares no model passes without a claim.

checks.title: Seven states per async module
checks.fix_hint: idle/loading/skeleton/populated/empty/error/success — designing only the ideal state is a defect [A.12].
